description: Work out the arithmetic of one to four proposed option legs: net debit or credit, payoff, breakevens and whole-position greeks. Long legs price at the ask and short legs at the bid; a leg without a usable quote falls back to its last trade, and the answer then says the result cannot be executed at. Legs in one expiration give a terminal payoff; legs in two give one result per path, since the back legs still carry time value at the front expiration. This is reference arithmetic, not a recommendation, and it states no probability of profit. Plus reads delayed indicative quotes, Pro real-time; the Free plan is answered with an upgrade note. US tickers only.

legs.description: One to four legs, each an OCC symbol, a side (long or short) and a quantity

contract.description: Exact OCC option symbol returned by the option chain or contract read.

quantity.description: Positive number of contracts for this leg (default 1, max 100).
